newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ANDERSEN HAT-TRICK TAKES RANGERS FURTHER IN FRONT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANDERSEN HAT-TRICK TAKES RANGERS FURTHER IN FRONT.

text.p: Danish duo Brian Laudrup and Erik Bo Andersen helped Rangers stretch their lead at the top of the Scottish premier division to 12 points on Tuesday.
Rangers recovered from the shock of a fourth minute opener by bottom club Kilmarnock through Ray Montgomerie to claim yet another Ibrox victory in their pursuit of a ninth successive title.
Andersen, standing in for Ally McCoist, scored a hat-trick and David Robertson once as Rangers streaked 12 points clear of Aberdeen at the top.
Arch rivals Celtic are 14 points adrift in third place but with three matches in hand.

It was Laudrup who orchestrated the Rangers revival while Andersen, tagged an Ibrox misfit' earlier in the season for missed chances, took his goal tally to six for the season and four in two appearances.

Andersen levelled the scores shortly before the interval and Rangers should have gone into the lead when they were awarded a penalty in first half injury time but Paul Gascoigne's weak effort was stopped by goalkeeper Dragoje Lekovic.
Rangers went 2-1 in front after 60 minutes when Laudrup brilliantly weaved his way to the touchline and David Robertson crashed the ball high into the net.
Four minutes later, the contest was all but over as Andersen diverted a shot from Steven into the net for his second.
His hat-trick was completed after 72 minutes as he brought down a cross from Alex Cleland and thrashed a shot beyond Lekovic.
